test_title: PYST 1: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which department has notified rules for the use of radar equipment to measure vehicle speed under the Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 2011?

options.text: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Consumer Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Department of Consumer Affairs operates under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food, and Public Distribution in India.
 
• It is responsible for formulating laws and policies for consumer protection, including the Legal Metrology Act, 2009.
 
• The Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 2011, regulate the use of measuring instruments, including radar equipment for speed detection.
 
• The department has notified rules for the usage of radar-based speed measurement equipment to ensure accuracy and standardization.
 
• These rules aim to maintain uniformity and reliability in speed enforcement mechanisms across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Legal Metrology Act, 2009:** This act governs the standards of weights and measures in India and ensures accuracy in trade and commerce.
 
• **Radar Speed Measurement:** Radar equipment uses electromagnetic waves to measure the speed of moving vehicles, commonly used for traffic law enforcement.
 
• **Consumer Protection:** The Department of Consumer Affairs also oversees consumer rights, product standards, and grievance redressal mechanisms.
 
• **Role of Legal Metrology:** Legal Metrology ensures the accuracy of measuring instruments, protecting both consumers and businesses from unfair practices.
 
• **Calibration of Instruments:** The notified rules emphasize the need for periodic calibration and certification of radar equipment to ensure measurement precision.
